title: MBTA Red Line — Davis Station
snippet: Davis Square is served by the MBTA Red Line with direct access to Harvard Square, Kendall Square, and downtown Boston.
full_text: Davis Station is served directly by the MBTA Red Line, giving Davis Square residents a one-seat ride to Harvard Square, Kendall Square, and downtown Boston. The square is also a hub for several bus routes and is considered highly bike-friendly.
claim_text: Davis Square has direct MBTA Red Line access to Harvard Square and downtown Boston, and is considered highly bike-friendly.
